records.title: Google Ads policies
records.verification_note: Official Google Ads policy centre retrieved on 2026-09-19. Open the specific content, targeting, destination, editorial and data-collection policy that applies to the campaign; Google may restrict, block or suspend non-compliant advertising.

records.title: Personalised advertising policy
records.verification_note: Official Google Restricted targeting in personalised advertising page retrieved on 2026-09-19. Do not pass PII through ad data segments, send precise location without consent, or target overly narrow audiences; review sensitive-interest and access-to-opportunities restrictions before launch.

records.title: How LinkedIn Content Wins in AI Search
records.verification_note: Vendor-produced observational analysis of 9.5 million citations from B2B prompts across 16 categories and six named AI products. Preserve the sample, denominator, date, and source; do not present findings as causal or universal ranking rules.
records.source_scope: Meltwater's named B2B prompt and citation sample; not a universal measure of LinkedIn, search, or LLM behaviour.
records.uncertainty: The report supports directional observations about cited content and source mix, but does not establish causation, traffic, lead quality, sales impact, or applicability to every market, language, product, or model.

records.title: AI Search and LinkedIn: 5 Takeaways from 9.5 Million Citations
